subject: Unforeseen electrical field condition: existing feeder conflicting with the new equipment

messages.text: We de-energized the circuit and logged the existing feeder conflicting with the new equipment pad at Electrical Closet 2A in today's field log; this isn't reflected in Sheet E-501. We would like this resolved ahead of the next work sequence. This condition will require a change order. No broader schedule impact is expected. A response within three days would be appreciated.
